changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6e item 5: TeamCollection now implements a narrow TeamsPort interface (submitToLeader, interruptLeader, dissolve, leaderScope, scheduler, runForLeader, history, summary, list, createFromRequest), each gating itself on the dispatcher's admission internally instead of being wrapped by the caller. TeamLeaderHandle, TeamLeaderTeammateOps, and the teamLeaderHandle() factory move from dispatcher-service/ into team/leader-handle.ts, fixing a layering inversion where service/agent/mcp.ts imported a type from the dispatcher-service directory that itself depends on service/agent/. DispatcherService.team() now forwards to TeamCollection.leaderScope() instead of building the handle itself. Internal ownership and file-location change only; DispatcherService's other Team pass-through methods and public Command/MCP surface are unchanged.

team.status already refused during a dispatcher stop; team.history and team.list now refuse the same way (SERVER_SHUTTING_DOWN) instead of answering from a Team's stale records. All three are per-Team operational reads and are now gated uniformly; dispatcher.list, dispatcher.status, and channel.list are unaffected and remain observable through a stop.
